meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 把 Linear 接成 Claude 的频道：指定团队里每个 issue 的评论都会触发它，不需要 @提及；每个 issue 的评论串各自成为一个独立会话，它就在该评论串里回复。
howto.when: 当有评论发到你接好的 Linear 团队（如 ENG）的 issue 上时触发，其他成员的评论也算，无需 @提及。由 webhook 驱动，新建 webhook 可能延迟 1–5 分钟。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接入进来
say.note: 会按 Apply 步骤复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: Linear 团队 key 是 ENG，我用个人 API Key 接入
把 Linear 团队接到这个 agent，发送者策略用 strict

howto.what_en: Adds Linear as a channel: every comment on an issue in the wired team triggers the agent with no @-mention, and each issue's comment thread becomes its own isolated session where it replies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a comment is posted on an issue in the Linear team you wired (e.g. ENG), including other members' comments, with no @-mention. Webhook-driven; new webhooks can lag 1-5 minutes.

say_en.text: Wire the Linear channel into my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, runs the registration test

say_en.text: Linear team key is ENG and I'll use a Personal API Key
say_en.note: Answer none at both OAuth prompts, then set LINEAR_API_KEY

say_en.text: Wire the Linear team to this agent with strict sender policy
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring with pattern engage mode
